sources.entry: Reaparr ⚠ - Cross-platform Plex media downloader that seamlessly adds media from other Plex servers to your own. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker

summary.one_liner: Reaparr is a cross-platform Plex media downloader that adds media from other Plex servers to your own, distributed as a Docker image under GPL-3.0.
summary.what_it_does: The README is nearly empty: it only links to www.reaparr.rocks, has a screenshots heading with no content, and asks readers to star the project and join a Discord. It contains no description of features, configuration, or usage. The awesome-selfhosted listing describes it as a cross-platform Plex media downloader that adds media from other Plex servers to your own, and marks it with a warning symbol and a Docker tag. Beyond that, details such as how it works or what platforms it runs on are not given in the README.
use_cases: download media from another Plex server
share Plex library content with a friend's server
add remote Plex media to my own server
notable: Listed on awesome-selfhosted under Media Management
caveats: README is nearly empty; no setup or usage instructions are provided
Marked with a warning symbol in the awesome-selfhosted listing, meaning the reason is not stated in the README
